---
title: "Main Ghulam-e-Haider-e-Karar Hoon Molai Hoon"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Yasir"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Main Ghulam-e-Haider-e-Karar Hoon Molai Hoon.
Hum Khiyal-e-Meesum-e-Tamar Hoon Molai Hoon.
Meri Peshani Pe Hai Khak-e-Najaf Jalwah Numa.
Main Yaqeenan Sahib-e-Dastar Hoon Molai Hoon.

2
Kar Ke Tukre Marhab-o-Antar Ke Boli Zulfiqar.
Haider-e-Karar Ki Talwar Hoon Molai Hoon.
Ahl-e-Matam Our Matam Ki Hifazat Ke Liye.
Main Sarapa Aahni Dewar Hoon Molai Hoon.

3
Shamil-e-Harf-e-Dua-e-Syeda Hoon Iss Liye.
Shah-e-Wala Ka Main Matamdar Hoon Molai Hoon.
Main Hoon Yasir Madah Khuwan-e-Hazrat-e-Shah-e-Umam.
Ba-Hunar Hoon Sahib-e-Kirdar Hoon Molai Hoon.

roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for edition, numerals in ((roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')):

    assert len(stanzas) == 3

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Urdu script, preserving the three stanzas and Yasir’s in-verse takhallus. Moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics` and verified that both versions have four verses per stanza.

Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`. I read “Our” as اور and “Antar” as عنتر, preserving their Roman spellings.
